record.summary: Passive.SAND_STREAM has NO PassiveEffects entry (routing uncertainty NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY) and its only reference outside the unit classes is app/utils/weather.ts getWeather. HIPPOPOTAS (1 star) and HIPPODOWN (2 stars) are GROUND + NORMAL, maxPP 100, range 1, skill SAND_TOMB. The passive does nothing in the fight itself; it adds to the weather vote that decides simulation.weather before a fight. For each such unit not on row 0, its GROUND type adds +1 to the SANDSTORM score (the ordinary type vote any GROUND unit gives) and SAND_STREAM adds a further +2 to both the match-wide boardWeatherScore and the per-board playerWeatherScore (which also gets +1 from the type vote): a total +3 on the match-wide SANDSTORM score per unit. The NORMAL type likewise adds +1 to NEUTRAL (also not from the passive). The dominant weather is the highest score; a tie for first place gives no dominant weather; the dominant weather applies only if its score is at least WeatherThreshold (8 for SANDSTORM), otherwise the weather is NEUTRAL. Both players' boards are scanned and the score is shared, so a SAND_STREAM unit on the opponent's board (not row 0) contributes just as much as one on the player's own board. What SANDSTORM then does in combat (for example status duration and shore-up / other weather checks) is not described here. The numbers +2, +1 and 8 are the requested contributions; weather rocks (+3 each) and the other passives of the +100 type are independent. No gameplay claims; source reading plus mechanical checks only.
triggers: Before a fight: getWeather(bluePlayer, redPlayer|null, redPlayerBoard, isGhostBattle) called from the game commands for PVE and for each matchup

effects.declaredRaw: +2 SANDSTORM score on top of the +1 type vote of the GROUND type
effects.scaling: none; fixed constants; no AP, star or luck scaling; Hippodown and Hippopotas contribute the same
effects.resolution: requested = applied: added to boardWeatherScore (shared by both boards) and to playerWeatherScore of the unit's board, once per GROUND type (these units have one). Skipped for units on row 0 (positionY 0 means bench). Not a stat helper or damage path, so no Big Eater Belt / Twist Band / Protect / Rune Protect involvement.

effects.declaredRaw: threshold 8 and a unique highest score
effects.resolution: the SANDSTORM score is compared with the other weather scores (ties for first give no dominant weather) and must reach WeatherThreshold 8; otherwise NEUTRAL. The result is passed as the weather of the Simulation for PVE and PVP.

conditions: Only units not on row 0 count (bench is positionY 0).
The extra +2 is only given inside the per-type loop when the type is GROUND (the weather mapped from that type is SANDSTORM); the NORMAL type gives the unit's NEUTRAL +1 only.
Because the match-wide score includes both boards, the passive supports sandstorm for either side of the fight.
The passive is a pure score contribution: it does not itself grant a stat, status or ability.
record.resetBehaviour: Recomputed from the boards for every fight; no persisted state.

inside the per-type loop: for a unit whose type maps to SANDSTORM and whose passive is SAND_STREAM, the SANDSTORM score gets an extra +2 on the match-wide boardWeatherScore and on the per-board playerWeatherScore
every type of a unit that maps to a weather adds +1 to boardWeatherScore of that weather
the per-board playerWeatherScore also gets +1 per mapped type (not for CASTFORM)
units on row 0 (bench) are skipped; both bluePlayer.board and redPlayerBoard are scanned
separate +100 mechanism for passives listed in PassivesAssociatedToWeather; SAND_STREAM is not in that map (its entry for SANDSTORM is Passive.SANDSTORM), so it does not use this path
GROUND maps to SANDSTORM, NORMAL maps to NEUTRAL; PassivesAssociatedToWeather lists Passive.SANDSTORM for SANDSTORM and does not list SAND_STREAM
dominant weather = highest score; a tie for the top score returns null
the dominant weather is used only if its score reaches WeatherThreshold, else NEUTRAL
the SANDSTORM threshold is 8 (every weather listed has 8)
PVE fights compute weather from the player board and the PVE board
PVP and ghost fights compute weather from both boards and pass it to the Simulation constructor
